name: print-social-music-fest-stories-yellow-mosaic-border-blue-white
title: 'Music Fest' story set with a colourful mosaic tile border framing blue-and-white event details
whatItIs: Four vertical yellow story cards each framed by a colourful mosaic tile border (musical notes, vinyl records, abstract shapes in pink, blue, orange), with a blue diamond 'MUSIC FEST' badge, date, DJ photos and 'Book Now Your Tickets' details.
whatItMeans: Festive and rhythmic; the mosaic border itself feels musical, like tiles arranged to a beat.
techniques: Frame content with a dense mosaic tile pattern border.
Rotate a diamond badge as the central event mark.
Keep the centre content area simple against a busy border.

vocabulary.definition: A frame made of many small repeating pattern tiles.
A rotated square used as a label shape.
